race.comment: MONSUN'S PRIDE (2) should take beating after a strong Kilmore second, beaten just under a length after leading and fighting on before being claimed late. His previous Kilmore fourth was better than it reads after he had difficulty getting clear, and he gets every chance on speed from the gate. SACRED INGOT (13) comes through BM52 grade at Wangaratta, where he started a well-supported favourite but only battled into fourth; the weight relief and stronger overall profile can see him bounce back. OUR PARAMOUR (12) drops out of a BM62 at Seymour after finishing seventh at long odds but looks better placed here and can bounce back. SLATE RIPPER (6) also gets grade relief after a BM66 seventh at Albury and his Yarra Valley third two back reads well enough to make him a genuine contender. RUSCELLO (10) is off a solid win at Albury and is in the mix.
